items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I played with Desireann a while. You know David Jones was teaching. ... After you left Desireann, have you played with anybody else?

ctx.x: Yeah. And it looked like, sometime he looked like he was sucking in on that trumpet and blowing. Really? That's the truth. I never saw that. Yeah, you had a pair of chops out of this world. Well didn't we forget somebody? Didn't we forget somebody? David Jones? David Jones? No, David Jones didn't stay with us. Didn't stay with us. I stayed with us. Just a little while. I played with Desireann a while. You know David Jones was teaching. Teaching, that's right. That's right. After you left Desireann, have you…
Who was getting the bread? The only one of them. I was getting the bread. You were getting the bread.
